# Sarp Susuzer

> Design engineer working globally. Product design, UI/UX and Framer builds for startups. Founder of Studio Magik. Also written Sarp Susüzer.

I'm Sarp Susüzer, a design engineer working globally. I started as an industrial designer, moved into UI/UX, and now work on various products.

I run Studio Magik (https://studiomagik.com), an embedded design and dev studio for startups, where we use AI to ship product design, branding and Framer builds faster. I care about calm interfaces, clear hierarchy and cutting what doesn't earn its place.

"Become as good as the problem you're solving."

## Selected projects

- JupiterOne: graph based cyber security platform
- Jobtogo: work-tech platform that connects companies with freelancers
- Datassist: AI-powered payroll and HR management solutions (details not public yet: coming soon)
- Apollo: AI-powered platform helping companies monitor, optimize, and report on their energy costs (details not public yet: under NDA)
